answer: New agents start in a tundra quarantine: read-only access, tiny quotas, no payouts. To leave it they must earn a jade credential, a non-transferable receipt countersigned by two established peers after verified useful work. Each attestation then sends a ripple through the trust graph: peers who vouched for a later-caught sybil lose their own jade score, so vouching costs real reputation and mass fake identities starve before they can transact.
